label: attention-safe visitor journeys, exact staging proof, production hold preserved
topWin: Independent prompt timers became one explicit visitor-attention budget, proven on new and returning desktop/mobile journeys across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
topGap: Production remains on the old bundle and passes only 3/15 attention cases because the full-site real-provider identity gate requires missing Obelisk relying-party configuration plus the founder passkey ceremony.
ignisNote: The strongest result was not merely reducing prompts but making interruption pressure one testable system; the equally important result was preserving the production identity hold and reporting the live 3/15 truth beside staging's 15/15.
